sources.title: Census Geocoder — coordinates to geography

access.notes: Public, no key. Vintage and benchmark are pinned in the endpoint.

caveats: Returns the Census geography containing a point; it does not confirm that a facility occupies that point.
Boundaries are a legal/statistical product, not a utility service territory.

sources.title: Form EIA-860 — Annual Electric Generator Report

access.notes: Annual ZIP. Pin the year in the profile; never cite an unpinned 'latest'. Parsers must report the file and row locator.

caveats: Generator nameplate is a generating capability, not a load-center demand.
Retirement and planned-capacity fields are as-of the filing date, not real time.

sources.title: EPA eGRID — Emissions & Generation Resource Integrated Database

access.notes: Annual workbook. Subregion output emission rates are the citation target; plant-level rates are a different predicate.

caveats: eGRID is an annual inventory, not a live marginal emissions signal.
Subregion averages can differ materially from the balancing authority serving a site at a given hour.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API

access.notes: Community-maintained, not a utility record. Public endpoint is rate-limited and returns 502 under load; the pipeline retries with exponential backoff and never treats a failed fetch as zero features.

caveats: Completeness varies by region and by mapper.
Voltage, operator and name tags are optional and frequently absent.
A missing feature is not evidence that the asset does not exist.

sources.title: GridSentinel generation layer (in-repo)
sources.license: Internal artifact — see upstream license and caveats

access.notes: A filtered, radius-clipped subset built from EIA-860 2025. The snapshot is the exact in-repo artifact; upstream row locators are not preserved by the subset.

caveats: Derived artifact: cite the layer for counts inside this radius, not for national EIA totals.
Nameplate MW is generator capability, not facility demand.

sources.title: GridSentinel transmission layer (in-repo)

access.notes: Radius-clipped Overpass snapshot. Voltage is the highest tagged voltage on the way, normalised at extraction time.

caveats: Line geometry reflects OSM mapping, not utility GIS.
Underground and low-voltage lines are excluded by the extraction rule.

sources.title: GridSentinel substation layer (in-repo)

access.notes: Radius-clipped Overpass snapshot; point is the outline centroid for way/relation features.

caveats: Presence in OSM is not proof of energisation.
Voltage and operator tags are incomplete.

sources.title: GridSentinel curated load-center records (in-repo)

access.notes: Curated from operator and agency records during the build sprint. Identity fields are real; electrical ratings and economics are modelled. Every row is addressable by JSON Pointer.

caveats: Nameplate MW is a modelled electrical rating derived from published scale, not an operator-published meter value.
Carbon intensity and source mix are modelled for the serving zone until an eGRID/ISO snapshot is captured.
Upgrade economics are screening estimates, not bids.

sources.title: Operator and agency records (manual capture)
sources.license: Publisher terms — quote and link, do not redistribute

access.notes: For PDFs, permits and board packets with no API. A human captures the file, records the page/quote locator, and the build hashes the exact file.

caveats: A manual capture is only as good as the locator: page number and verbatim quote are mandatory.
Do not claim a number from a secondary summary when the primary filing is available.
